map.例：丁腈橡胶 NBR（基准 8000h、适宜 80℃、上限 120℃）、油介质、: Example: nitrile rubber NBR (base 8000 h, suitable 80 C, upper limit 120 C), oil media, 80 C / 5 MPa / 1500 rpm gives temperature factor 1, pressure factor 0.779, speed factor 0.741, estimated life 4616 h (about 192 days), linear velocity 3.93 m/s, PV = 19.64 MPa m/s exceeds limit, grade medium. Temperature rises to 130 C (exceeds NBR limit) gives temperature factor drops sharply to 0.05, life only 231 h, prompts temperature exceeds material limit, need to change material. Switch to PTFE (base 25000 h, suitable 150 C) at 150 C / 2 MPa / 500 rpm gives three factors 1 / 0.905 / 0.905, life 20468 h (about 853 days), grade excellent.
map.PV 值为什么会超限？: Why does the PV value exceed the limit?
The PV limit is a conservative reference under dry friction / boundary lubrication. This example 5 MPa times 3.93 m/s = 19.6 far exceeds 0.3, indicating this condition must ensure adequate lubrication and heat dissipation, or switch to a low-friction material and reduce linear velocity; if there is a good oil film in practice, relax per the manufacturer PV curve.

map.预计寿命(h) = 材料基准寿命 × 温度因子 × 压力因子 × 速度因子 ×: Expected life (h) = material base life × temperature factor × pressure factor × speed factor × medium factor
map.PV 值 = 压力(MPa) × 线速度(m/s)；线速度 = 转速 × 轴径(: PV value = pressure (MPa) × linear speed (m/s); linear speed = speed × shaft diameter (mm)/1000 × π ÷ 60 (shaft diameter from input, default 50 mm)
map.压力因子 = e^(−压力 ÷ 20)；速度因子 = 转速>0 ? e^(−转速: Pressure factor = e^(−pressure ÷ 20); speed factor = speed>0 ? e^(−speed ÷ 5000) : 1
map.PV 限值：PTFE 0.5｜其他 0.3 MPa·m/s；等级：≥10000h: PV limit: PTFE 0.5 | others 0.3 MPa·m/s; grades: >=10000 h excellent | >=5000 good | >=1000 moderate | <1000 poor
map.NBR 耐温 -30~120℃、FKM -20~200℃、EPDM -50~15: Temperature ranges: NBR −30 to 120 °C, FKM −20 to 200 °C, EPDM −50 to 150 °C, VMQ −60 to 200 °C, PTFE −200 to 260 °C; outside the range shows unavailable/very short life.
map.算法：温度按 Arrhenius Q10=2，超上限 20℃ 内取 0.05、超: Algorithm: Arrhenius temperature factor with Q10 = 2; within 20 °C above the limit use 0.05, above by more than 20 °C use 0.001; below the low-temperature limit use 0.001; otherwise 2^((preferred temperature − operating temperature)/10), floor 0.001. Pressure factor = e^(−p/20); speed factor = e^(−rpm/5000) (1 at rest); medium factor: oil 1, water 0.9, gas 0.7, chemical 0.6. Estimated life = base life × four factors (floor 10 h). PV: linear speed = rpm × shaft diameter (mm)/1000 × π/60 (diameter from input, default 50 mm); PV = pressure × linear speed; limits PTFE 0.5, others 0.3 MPa·m/s. Base life: NBR 8000 h, FKM 15000 h, EPDM 12000 h, VMQ 10000 h, PTFE 25000 h.
map.温度因子：超上限≤20℃ 取 0.05；超上限 20℃ 以上或低于材料下限取 0: Temperature factor: within 20 °C above the material limit use 0.05; more than 20 °C above the limit, or below the low-temperature limit, use 0.001; otherwise 2^((preferred − operating temperature) ÷ 10); global floor 0.001.
map.Q10=2 表示温度每升高 10℃ 老化速率翻倍、寿命减半。超过材料上限 20℃: Q10 = 2 means every 10 °C rise doubles aging and halves life. Within 20 °C above the material limit the factor is 0.05 (only 5% life left); more than 20 °C above the limit, or below the low-temperature limit, it is 0.001 (treated as decomposition / permanent failure); the global floor is 0.001. Temperature limits are therefore a hard constraint in material selection, followed by pressure and speed optimization.
